verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Alloy is an automated fraud and KYC decisioning platform. The evidence shows only nearby features. There are evaluation results, a services/warnings breakdown, webhooks that fire 'when ... a manual review occurs', and a marketing claim of 'fully auditable agentic automation'. Nothing documents a human overriding an automated decision while the original evidence and rationale are preserved alongside the override.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can inspect and override an automated remediation decision while preserving its original evidence and rationale
